svg.title: Bullroarer, convex narrow tapered
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. A bullroarer blade, convex narrow tapered, drawn by bullroarer.rs --blade=convex-narrow-tapered. Cut it in 3mm Baltic birch, face grain along the blade. Green #00ff00 cuts the cord hole first, then black #000000 frees the blade.
